caption: The drawing features a variety of geometric and organic shapes arranged across a patchwork of colored sections. The background is divided into rectangles filled with different patterns and colors: the upper left segment is brown with a quilted diamond pattern, the middle and lower left segments are blue with vertical dashed lines, the lower center is red-orange with a diagonal quilted pattern, and the right side is green with looping stitched designs. A curved green band runs diagonally from the lower left to the upper right, intersected by a round, blue spiked shape placed near the center. There are four triangular forms throughout the composition: two are black with tan borders and semicircular clusters of purple, gray, and red, positioned in the lower center and middle left; one is red-orange with a blue border and clusters of purple, brown, and pink, placed in the upper left; and one is red-orange with a black border and a similar scalloped edge, placed right of center. Another partial black shape with multi-colored scallops appears along the far left side. The shapes and patterns are outlined in black, and the colors are bold and solid with visible brush textures. The lower border of the image has the text "L1763 - C." written on the left and "Ruth M. Barnes." written on the right.
title: Coverlet (Applique Quilt)
